routes.name: Exact seed reconstruction, tangent lift, real density, and rank-20 deformation

C9000095.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 095 (Hyperbolicity cones without semidefinite lifts.; papers: Hyperbolicity Cones Without Semidefinite Lifts; A nonspectrahedral hyperbolicity cone; An Exact Semidefinite Lift of a Nonspectrahedral Hyperbolicity Cone; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/095.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

HS_RESOLVE.statement: Resolve the literal seed certificate, without inferring the downstream no-lift theorem.

HS_SEED.statement: Lemma Seed matrix: a real PSD rank-20 Hankel form has positive definite L block, injective Sym^2 K multiplication, cubic spanning, and dim(J H0)=321.

HS_ARITHMETIC.statement: At the stated F_7 parameter and tangent, every advertised basis, minor, corner, signed-pivot sequence, and all-weight rank total 136,84,302,623 agrees with exact reconstruction.

HS_TANGENT_LIFT.statement: A modulus-seven tangent and its decisive minors lift to exact characteristic-zero tangent data with denominators prime to seven.

HS_REAL_DATA.statement: All weight conditions hold simultaneously for real positive orbit data and a real tangent.

HS_DEFORMATION.statement: The tangent integrates in the rank-20 PSD Hankel stratum and increases dim(J H0) from 302 to exactly 321.

HL_NO_LIFT.statement: The staged high-dimensional construction gives a hyperbolicity cone with no finite semidefinite lift.

HL_FINITE_LIMITS.statement: Uniform rank correction, finite normalized fibers, and all permitted finite inverse limits are valid, including divergent eigenvalue sequences.

HL_SEPARATION.statement: The finite inverse classes imply separation from the Hankel-image closure and an everywhere PSD quadratic Q.

HL_OBSTRUCTION.statement: Moment deformation and feasible approximation exclude every finite affine lift of the epigraph of Q.

HL_HYPERBOLICITY.statement: An admissible Q yields the claimed hyperbolic polynomial and exact epigraph section/projection.
